name: Bernard King
summary: Scoring-focused forward; coverage centers entirely on offense, no defensive honors; generally viewed as indifferent/average defender.

name: Kevin McHale
summary: All-Defensive First Team 1986, 1987, 1988; long-armed post defender and shot blocker.

name: Terry Porter
summary: Strong, solid two-way point guard; no defensive honors; sources focus on offense and leadership.

name: Mark Price
summary: Small offensive point guard; no defensive reputation found; generally regarded as a defensive weakness due to size.

name: Elgin Baylor
summary: Coverage is offense/rebounding; Tom Heinsohn praised him as a defender among comparable forwards, but little else.

name: Mookie Blaylock
summary: All-Defensive First Team 1994 and 1995; ~2.5 steals per game, pesky ball hawk.

name: Marques Johnson
summary: All-NBA scorer; no All-Defensive honors; defense not a theme in coverage.

name: Alvin Robertson
summary: 1986 DPOY, steals leader 1986 and 1987, All-Defensive 2nd 1986 and 1st 1987.

name: Bobby Jones
summary: All-Defensive First Team every year 1977-84; defense was his Hall of Fame calling card.

name: Bob Lanier
summary: Big body who 'dominated the middle on defense'; 3.0 blocks per game in 1973-74; no All-Defensive selections in window.

name: Artis Gilmore
summary: ABA All-Defensive regular; NBA All-Defensive 2nd team 1978; elite shot blocker (11 blocks game).

name: Larry Nance
summary: All-Defensive First Team 1989; renowned shot-blocking forward.

name: Bob Pettit
summary: Sources focus on scoring/rebounding and relentless effort; nothing specific on defense.

name: Grant Hill
summary: Athletic, willing defender; rookie said he needed to improve defense; later assigned to guard Anthony Mason; no honors.

name: Shaquille O'Neal
summary: Intimidating rim presence (blocks) but young, not known for defensive intelligence; no All-Defensive honors.

name: Tiny Archibald
summary: NBA.com: defense 'spotty', struggled as defender; Kings let teammates handle defense.

name: Adrian Dantley
summary: Critics charged he neither played defense nor ran the floor.

name: Walter Davis
summary: Smooth scoring wing; one retrospective references solid defense; no honors.

name: Joe Dumars
summary: All-Defensive 1st 1990, 1992, 2nd 1991; Jordan called him the best defender he faced.

name: Sleepy Floyd
summary: Offensive guard; no defensive reputation in sources.

name: Tim Hardaway
summary: Run TMC era with little team defense; Nelson confronted him on defense; quick hands but no honors.

name: Hersey Hawkins
summary: Steady ~1.7-1.8 steals per game; no defensive write-ups or honors.

name: Elvin Hayes
summary: All-Defensive Second Team 1974 and 1975; ~3 blocks per game in 1974.

name: Dominique Wilkins
summary: Rapped for little interest in defense; left his man early to run; improved somewhat by 1988.

name: Brad Daugherty
summary: Skilled offensive center; teammate Hot Rod Williams said at times he wasn't there on defense; average.

name: Alex English
summary: Self-described decent defender in Moe's run-and-gun system; no honors.

name: Shawn Kemp
summary: Athletic shot blocker (~2 blocks) on aggressive Sonics defenses, but foul-prone.

name: Dikembe Mutombo
summary: 1995 DPOY, blocks leader 1994-96, 1994 upset of Sonics.

name: Paul Arizin
summary: NBA.com profile calls him a 'tough defender', otherwise sources center on scoring.

name: Phil Chenier
summary: Scoring guard; no defensive descriptions found.
